options.opa: It is a H2 blocker used in peptic ulcer disease
options.opd: It can also lead to tachycardia

analysis: Nizatidine is an H2 receptor antagonist used primarily for the treatment of peptic ulcer disease, which is true (option opa). However, its bioavailability is not 100%; it is approximately 70-80% (option opb is incorrect). Nizatidine does not enhance gastric emptying, as its mechanism of action is to reduce gastric acid secretion rather than promote motility (option opc is incorrect). Lastly, while Nizatidine can have side effects, tachycardia is not a common or well-documented side effect associated with its use (option opd is also incorrect). Therefore, the statement that is not true about Nizatidine is that it has 100% bioavailability (option opb).
